sources.title: Galio Build Guide: [26.19] Hexeria's detailed Masters Guide to Galio

passive.name: Colossal Smash
passive.text: Every few seconds, Galio's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage in an area.

spells.name: Winds of War
spells.text: Galio fires two windblasts that converge into a large tornado that deals damage over time.

spells.name: Shield of Durand
spells.text: Galio charges a defensive stance, moving slowly. Upon releasing the charge, Galio will taunt and damage nearby enemies.

spells.name: Justice Punch
spells.text: Galio will briefly step back and charge, knocking up the first enemy champion he encounters.

spells.name: Hero's Entrance
spells.text: Galio designates an ally's position as his landing spot, granting all allies in the area a magic shield. After a delay Galio smashes down location, knocking up nearby enemies.

damage.value: Galio deals burst magic damage in an area with Colossal Smash.

archetype.value: Galio can be built as a bruiser for mid or top, with assassin and support builds also listed.

axis.value: Galio can poke from range with Winds of War before closing in to taunt.

spikes.why: Galio gains mana and other stats the guide says he needs, though the item gives up some early-game value.
Galio benefits from their strong pairing.

mistakes.value: Galio can run short of mana and lack abilities for a fight if his build provides no mana source.
Galio can struggle to keep abilities ready for a fight without some source of mana.
Galio players who neglect mana may struggle to keep abilities ready for a fight.
